outcome: Time to achieve feeding amounts of 120 ml/(kg.d) and 150 ml/(kg.d)
Proportion of peripherally inserted central catheter (PICC) use
Number of red blood cell transfusions
cohort: 91 very low birth weight (VLBW) or extremely low birth weight (ELBW) preterm infants with birth weight <1500 g
finding: Supplementing VLBW and ELBW infants with fortified donor human milk, when mother's own milk was insufficient, shortened the time to achieve enteral nutrition and reduced the use rate and time of PICC, the incidence of late-onset sepsis, and the number of red blood cell transfusions.
